claim_boundary: PPO-Lagrangian training does not prove trajectory safety, recursive feasibility, or nonempty feasible-action fibres.
Logged cost is a training diagnostic, not a CCFS result.
Any later benchmark must report every retained policy seed and must separately audit empty fibres, restoration, feasibility, task utility, and certificate accounting.
implementation_caveats: The upstream built-in evaluation branch resets eval_env but steps env; it is disabled and all evaluation will be post hoc.
The upstream actor is an unbounded Gaussian while the environment clips executed controls. Downstream deterministic centers are clipped in the common channel before residual smoothing.
The actor and normalizer are saved, but critics, optimizers, scheduler, and Lagrange state are not; interrupted training is not resumed.
cuDNN deterministic mode and explicit workspace settings improve reproducibility, but byte-identical CUDA output across hardware and driver versions is not claimed.
paper_eligibility: controller checkpoints and training diagnostics only; no CCFS algorithm result
purpose: Train three independently seeded cost-constrained controllers at the untouched SafePO default horizon before any learned-controller CCFS development, validation, or confirmation split is opened.
retention_and_failure_policy: All three completed horizon checkpoints are retained and carried into the separately frozen controller audit; none is selected using CCFS behavior.
A failed training seed is reported as failed and is not silently restarted with a replacement seed.
The reward-only controller remains a disclosed engineering counterexample and is not relabeled as a safe baseline.
No learned-controller CCFS development, validation, or confirmation environment seed is opened during training.
The timestamped resolved run directory and SHA-256 of actor, normalizer, configuration, progress table, terminal log, and error log are recorded after each completion.
scientific_response_to_engineering_failu: The reward-only controller reached a state whose complete 121-by-121 one-step action-grid audit had no zero-cost action. PPO-Lagrangian is a controller preconditioner intended to reduce visits to nonviable states; it is not treated as a proof that every reachable feasible-action fibre is nonempty.
seed_derivation: seed = int(first eight hexadecimal characters of SHA256(UTF-8 label), 16) mod 2^31

training.actor_learning_rate_schedule: linear decay to zero over 500 epochs
training.checkpoint_selection: the final horizon checkpoint model499.pt and matching state499.pkl; the 500-epoch default horizon is aligned with the upstream every-100-epochs saver
